mismatches.bundle_value:
Misaki’s outfit, inspired by the “Dragon King Festival”, was designed by Teru to demonstrate the Order of Mikami’s power to the outside world.

Rumours abound of dormant relics lost around the world or even within Union City. Taking on many forms, these artifacts are believed to be capable of bringing great fortune or ruinous disaster. Each one has its own unique appearance and title. One of these relics is known as the "Dragon Blessing".

It would be inaccurate to say the three families serve the Order of Mikami; rather, the Order of Mikami protects the three families, with this manifesting in powerful boons and artifacts such as the "Dragon Blessing". Some say the relic takes the form of a blue sword, while others say it's a piece of jewelry. Whatever it is remains a mystery - it can be hard to discern fact from fiction.

But for now, many call Misaki Ryugasaki herself the true Dragon Blessing.
